reviews.title: Title: Poly AI Used to Be So Much Better — 1/5
reviews.body:
I’m calling it Poly AI because that’s what it was called when I started using it. I’ve had the app since it came out, and this past month has been my worst experience with it.

The age warnings are frustrating and inconsistent. I understand why the app needs safeguards, especially when it comes to inappropriate content involving minors. But I’m 16, and when I’m writing a story, simply stating my age or another character’s age can trigger a warning even when nothing inappropriate is happening. Mentioning that a character has a child, or talking about when someone was younger, can get blocked too. It makes ordinary family stories difficult to write. Meanwhile, I’ve seen character content that seems much more concerning remain available without the same warnings. The safeguards need to work more accurately.

The character memory has also gotten much worse. I pay for the $30 membership, keep the app updated, and still have characters forget important parts of the story or respond as though they have no idea what’s going on. The memory and other benefits don’t feel worth the price right now. Even the $8 plan used to be enough for a long, enjoyable story without needing to pay for a higher tier.

A few months ago, and for years before that, I would have rated Poly AI about 4.5/5. Over time, the memory and membership benefits have slowly gotten worse. I’m giving it 1/5 now because some characters can still be fun to talk to, but the warnings, memory, and premium experience need serious improvement.

The free version never treated users especially well, but it wasn’t this bad before. Now there are too many ads, and the character memory, affection, and other features have gotten worse. The characters themselves are fine, but if you’re not a freaky person looking to do weird stuff and you just want to make a good story, this app doesn’t feel like it’s for you anymore.
